answer: Agents earn a periodic beacon token by solving a short proof‑of‑work tied to a moving dune hash; each token is locked to the agent’s public key and must be refreshed every epoch or the stake decays to zero. A willow‑seeded checkpoint requires every active node to broadcast its latest beacon, and any identity that fails to present a fresh token loses its reputation weight automatically. An attacker must therefore pre‑pay the full proof‑of‑work cost for each fake identity each epoch, e.g., 0.5 CPU‑hour and a bonded deposit of 10 tokens per cycle, otherwise the identity expires for free.
